provenance.line: the cloudtrail_event builder lifts the event out of the LookupEvents record's CloudTrailEvent string, and the test_aws_fetch_cloudtrail_success assertions use this exact source name
provenance.note: The row is the bare CloudTrail event, the shape CloudTrail delivers to S3, with the fetcher's three delivery keys appended. None of the LookupEvents fields (EventId, EventName, Username, Resources) survive the builder. The variant is the dotted <provider>.<stream> string the fetcher was configured with, so the variant space is open rather than enumerable -- detection reads the value, it does not match it against a list.
